diagnostic.B: large parent buffers, split calls: matched control for C
diagnostic.C: compact512 buffers, exactly same calls and strip batches as B
diagnostic.D: shared exact XYZ/UV/RGBA tuples per parent; same calls and ordered strips as A
diagnostic.key0: cycle available A/B/C/D, freeze input without changing pose
diagnostic.selection: same GRID face selection, ordered strips, alpha/depth/materials in all four
diagnostic.vertex_identity: packed signed-short XYZ, short UV, byte RGBA; same scale/bias; no epsilon, no cross-material merging
diagnostic.masks: lazy paired B/C and D indices; no fixed-mask rebuild after warmup
diagnostic.alpha: original cutout thresholds ON, no disable key
diagnostic.native_stages: J prepare, B bind, K camera/state/clear, R render loop, E release; coarse wall time, NOT GPU timestamps
diagnostic.counters: T triangles, DC calls, VB submitted capacity sum, S selected corners, RES resident vertices, AV available modes, N/C/I API wall time
diagnostic.failure: optional layouts disabled on OOM; explicit A recovery, never silently relabelled; no visibility substitution

purpose: Controlled organization tests, not an FPS claim. Compare B/C at matched calls, A/D at matched calls; hold camera/geometry/materials fixed.
